title: Authorship and Publication of 'Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs: Opportunities and Challenges'
summary: This community centers on the collaborative authorship of the paper 'Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs: Opportunities and Challenges.' The work was published in the journal TGDK (Volume 1, Issue 1) in 2023. It involves a large, interdisciplinary team of 17 researchers who contributed to this specific survey on the intersection of LLMs and Knowledge Graphs.
key_findings: The paper 'Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs: Opportunities and Challenges' was published in the journal TGDK in 2023 (Volume 1, Issue 1).
The publication features a large collaborative team consisting of 17 distinct authors.
Key contributors include Jeff Z. Pan, Simon Razniewski, Jan-Christoph Kalo, and Sneha Singhania, among others.

The paper is cited in the context of other related works, such as 'Unifying Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs: A Roadmap' (2024) and 'A Retrieve-and-Read Framework for Knowledge Graph Link Prediction' (2023).
The author list includes researchers such as Angela Bonifati, Gerard de Melo, and Mauro Dragoni, indicating a broad scope of expertise.
The paper spans 38 pages (2:1–2:38), suggesting a comprehensive treatment of the topic.
